about.title: iHELP Charitable Foundation – Humanitarian Aid for Ukraine in War
about.description: Support iHELP, a Ukrainian charitable foundation delivering food, medicine, and emergency aid.

home.title: iHELP Charity Foundation – reliable support for Ukraine in the most difficult times
home.description: The iHELP charity foundation has been helping Ukraine since 2022: humanitarian aid, community reconstruction, and support for children. Join us

privacy.title: Privacy | iHELP
privacy.description: Welcome to iHELP Privacy. Discover our projects and ways to get involved.

terms.title: Terms | iHELP
terms.description: Welcome to Terms of Use iHELP. Discover our projects and ways to get involved.

frontlinePeople.title: Humanitarian aid to frontline zones | iHELP Ukraine
frontlinePeople.description: Frontline areas are a daily struggle for life. iHELP provides humanitarian and medical assistance, supports hospitals and rescuers in the most difficult conditions.

socialTaxi.title: Social taxi for people with limited mobility | iHELP Kherson region
socialTaxi.description: The iHELP social taxi helps people with disabilities and people with limited mobility safely get to hospitals, social services, and rehabilitation centers in front-line areas of the Kherson region.

khersonChildren.title: Supporting children and education during war | iHELP
khersonChildren.description: The iHELP initiative helps children in frontline communities receive what they need for education, development, and survival, as well as feel supported and united.

projects.title: iHELP projects - from humanitarian aid to the reconstruction of Ukraine
projects.description: The projects of the iHELP charitable foundation unite volunteers, communities, businesses, and authorities to support people and create a foundation for the sustainable development of Ukraine.

contact.title: Contacts iHELP - Partnership, assistance, cooperation
contact.description: Official contacts of the iHELP Foundation. Write to us to receive information or to join in helping Ukraine.
